translation.name: Gu ñio'ki'ñ gu Dios na bhaan tu a'ga guch xoi'kam

book.name: MAARKOS
book.title: GUX BHAIꞌM KAIꞌCHDHAM ÑIꞌOOK NA BHAAN TU AꞌGA GUCH XOIꞌKAM NAT TU UAꞌNAK GU MAARKOS

content: Gu Jesuus nap kaiꞌch na cham jir am nam jax tu jimdat gu bɨjɨk dɨr kam
Baꞌ janoꞌ na miꞌ ka oirɨ gu Jesuus, miꞌ ba ai mɨt bhammɨ dɨr jaꞌk Jerusaleen guiꞌ nam pariseos jum tɨɨtɨꞌndaꞌ gio baꞌ guiꞌ nam sap jix mat kaꞌ gu ñioꞌkiꞌñ gu Dios.
Baꞌ moo ampɨk jup ba ji chu juu mɨt gu jaꞌtkam tugiꞌñ gu Jesuus, baꞌ ba ja tɨɨ mɨt na mɨt jaiꞌ dhɨt cham muiꞌkim jum iꞌkoim, na guꞌ sap jix xidhuu kaꞌ noꞌ cham muiꞌkim ikoimdhix gu jaroiꞌ.

Na guꞌ guiꞌ nam pariseos jum tɨɨtɨꞌndaꞌ gio gu jaiꞌ Israel kam jaꞌtkam, pui miꞌ puiꞌ tu daaꞌñchuꞌ am nam jax jaꞌk tu jimdat gu bɨjɨk dɨr kam kat, na sap noꞌm cham muiꞌkim ikoimdhix, cham jir am nam gan tu kuaꞌdaꞌ, nam guꞌ sap jum uaꞌtulhdhaꞌ.

Gio jaiꞌ cham daaxix kam, puiꞌ na jax gu jaroiꞌ noꞌt jii paiꞌ na bɨxchuꞌ tum gaꞌra, jum aaꞌndaꞌ sap na muiꞌkim batbiaꞌ jaꞌk gɨɨsɨi, na guꞌ sap jix xidhuu na tu jugiaꞌ noꞌt jax dhuuk cham muiꞌkim batbia. Gio gam gu tuꞌ na bhaan tu ioꞌdaꞌ na muiꞌkim ja bopkondaꞌ, gio gu bhiꞌmkar, gio baꞌ gu tuꞌ na bhaan dadarrɨdaꞌ na paiꞌ dhuuk ba ji chu jugiaꞌ.

Miꞌ dhɨr baꞌ bhaiꞌ ji chɨkka mɨt gu Jesuus guiꞌ nam pariseos jum tɨɨtɨꞌndaꞌ gio guiꞌ nam sap jix mat kaꞌ gu ñioꞌkiꞌñ gu Dios, jup tɨtda am: ―¿Jax kum baꞌ dhim jaꞌtkam tuk cham miꞌ puiꞌ ka jimchuꞌ nam jax tu jimdat guch bopxikat? Tɨɨꞌ nam cham muiꞌkim jum iꞌkoimdhat tu kuaꞌ.

Baꞌp ja tɨtda gu Jesuus: ―Dho puiꞌ na jax aapiꞌm na pim guꞌ cham tuꞌ miꞌ puiꞌ jiim na pim jax jaꞌk tu ja aꞌgiꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam nam tuiꞌñgɨdaꞌ. Bak guꞌr puiꞌ nat jax tu uaꞌnak miꞌ uꞌuan taꞌm gu Isaiiyas guiꞌ nat muiꞌkim bha ñioꞌkdhak guñ Gɨꞌkoraꞌ, nap jum kaiꞌch:

content.text: Dhi jaꞌtkam puiꞌ xi kaiꞌch am nam sap tuꞌ kaꞌm jiñ ñɨiꞌñ,
guꞌ ji na guꞌ gu ja jujur mɨk jaꞌk jup tuꞌiiꞌ aañ jiñ bui.
¿Tuꞌm gi miꞌp tɨgiaꞌ siam bɨɨx aixim tu daan?
Nam guꞌ cham tuꞌ miꞌ puiꞌ jiim nañ jax jix aaꞌ,
gio na guꞌ nam jɨꞌk jax tu ja aꞌgiꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam,

content: ’Jix matgam dho ―jup kaiꞌch gu Jesuus―, na pim guꞌ jaꞌp xi dhuukat na jax jix aaꞌ gu Dios. Dai na pim miꞌ puiꞌ tu daaꞌñchuꞌ nam jax tu jimdat gu bɨjɨk dɨr kam kat nam muiꞌkim ja bopkondat gu tuꞌ nam bhaan tu ioꞌdaꞌ, gio jaiꞌ cham aagix kam ku pim pu tu buim.
’Guꞌ baꞌ na jax jix aaꞌ gu Dios, tuꞌ pɨx ɨlhiiꞌñ japim. Dai na pim mu jaꞌk jix chutkagix na pim jax ɨlhiiꞌñ dɨɨlh.

¿Moo jaꞌp cham jam aꞌm baapak aa? Gi nat jaꞌpni tu uaꞌnak bo gu Moisees nap jum kaiꞌch miꞌ uꞌuan taꞌm: “Tuꞌ kaꞌm jap nɨidhat gum taat gio gum naan.” Gio baꞌ moo jaꞌpnip jum kaiꞌch ɨp: “Gu jaroiꞌ na cham tuꞌ kaꞌm nɨiꞌñdhaꞌ gu taataꞌn piam gu dɨꞌɨɨꞌn, pɨx am tɨꞌñchokaꞌ na joodai kɨꞌn maꞌyaxix kam muukix kaꞌ.”

Guꞌ ji na guꞌ aapiꞌm jix ioꞌm maakam ba xi buim, jaꞌp jum aaꞌ pim nar am na jaꞌp tɨɨdaꞌ gu jaroiꞌ gu taataꞌn piam gu dɨꞌɨɨꞌn: “Puiꞌ ba tɨɨꞌn jañich gu Dios nañ bɨɨx mu tu tuꞌaaꞌ chiop nañ jɨꞌk tu biaꞌ. Cham ka bhaaiꞌ nañ jax dhuim taiñbuidhaꞌ, sia ku jaꞌp moo tɨim aꞌm jum aaꞌ.”
Dai noꞌt puꞌñi ba tɨɨꞌn gu taataꞌn piam gu dɨꞌɨɨꞌn, aapiꞌm puiꞌ ba tɨꞌyaꞌ na miꞌ puiꞌ ba jimchuꞌ na jax jix aaꞌ guñ Gɨꞌkoraꞌ, jaꞌp moo sɨlhkam xi kaiꞌchdhaꞌ pim.

Ba xi jii pimɨt na pim bɨɨx aixim tu bua bhaan jim iatat nam jax tu jimdat gu bɨjɨk dɨr kam. Guꞌ baꞌ na jax jix aaꞌ gu Dios, gampaiꞌ pɨx biaꞌ pim, panaas ku pu cham tuꞌ bhaiꞌ, gio jaiꞌ cham aagix kam ku pim pu tu buim.
Gu Jesuus nap kaiꞌch na cham xidhuu gu jax chuꞌm koiꞌ
Baꞌ gu Jesuus maap ja jumpadak gu muiꞌ jaꞌtkam jup ja tɨtda: ―Ka na pim moox bhaiꞌ xiñ kaayaꞌ bɨɨx na pim jɨꞌk yaꞌp tuꞌiiꞌ nañ jax jam tɨɨdaꞌ.
Jax dhui na guꞌ cham tuꞌ xidhuu noꞌ moo tu kuaꞌ pɨx gu jaroiꞌ, guꞌ ji noꞌx bhaamut naiꞌ tɨtɨɨꞌñcho, piam ku jax ña pɨx jum aaꞌ na jax cham jir am na baꞌx xidhuu, na guꞌr uaꞌtulhdharaꞌ.
Miꞌ pim puiꞌ ba jimiaꞌ jɨꞌk na pim jix maatɨt jiñ kɇɇ.
Baꞌ miꞌ puiꞌ xi ja tɨtdaimɨk pu jii mummu na paiꞌ tɨbiapkaꞌ. Baꞌ nat mu ba ai, ba tɨkka am gu noonbiꞌñ na jax kaiꞌñkam jup kaiꞌch gu puiꞌ na jax ja tɨtda gu muiꞌ jaꞌtkam.
Baꞌp ja tɨtda: ―¿Aapiꞌm aa puiꞌ cham maatɨt jup tɇ kɇɇ? Jaꞌp jañ dho kaiꞌch na cham tuꞌ xidhuu noꞌ moo tu kuaꞌ pɨx gu jaroiꞌ,

na guꞌ sɨlh bookaran jaꞌk bhɨɨyaꞌ gu koiꞌ, miꞌ dhɨr dai na giop ba buusniaꞌ, cham tuꞌ na juraꞌran jaꞌk baapkɨi miꞌx buam ba jurtuꞌnkaꞌ. Baꞌ dhiꞌ na puiꞌ jɨꞌ kaiꞌch gu Jesuus, jaꞌp kaiꞌñkam jup kaiꞌch na sap cham tuꞌ xidhuu gu tuꞌ koiꞌ, pu ni jax chuꞌm.
Baꞌ jaꞌpnip ja tɨtda: ―Guꞌ ji noꞌx bhaamut naiꞌ tɨtɨɨꞌñchu gu jaroiꞌ piam ku jax ña pɨx jum aaꞌ nax buam jir jum duukam na baꞌx xidhuu, na guꞌr uaꞌtulhdharaꞌ.

Na guꞌ kaiꞌñkam ja jujur am dɨr gu jaꞌtkam na bhaiꞌ jim gɨgɨꞌlhiꞌñ gux buam jum duukam, jax ñam pɨx bam aaꞌndaꞌ, jaꞌp na jax guiꞌ nam jaiꞌ jix bhaiꞌ ja tɨtdadaꞌ gu uꞌuub sia kum tɨi tɨ bɨpnaꞌ, gio gu uꞌuub ba puiꞌ ɨp. Gio guiꞌ nam cham tɨɨmuiꞌx kaꞌ, siam tɨi maap tu oiꞌdhaꞌ. Gio guiꞌ nam jaꞌtkam ja kooꞌndaꞌ.

Gio guiꞌ nam tɨ ɨɨxiꞌñdhaꞌ. Gio guiꞌ nam jix bhaamut nɨiꞌñdhaꞌ gu jaroiꞌ noꞌ tuꞌ biaꞌ, nam jaiꞌ puiꞌp jix aagɨt. Gio guiꞌ nam jax ñam pɨx tu buadaꞌ na jax cham jir am. Gio guiꞌ nam iatdaꞌ. Gio guiꞌ nam jotmodaꞌ pɨx jix bhaiꞌ tɨɨdaꞌ gu ubii, miꞌ dhɨr jumai ɨp. Gio guiꞌ nam jix chɨ jɨɨgak kaꞌ. Gio guiꞌ nam giilhim tu ñiok. Gio guiꞌ nam jix buam ja aꞌgadaꞌ gu jaꞌtkam. Gio guiꞌ nam gɇꞌgɇrkam jum taat kaꞌ. Gio guiꞌ nam bɨɨx aixim tu buadaꞌ, panaas kum cham ja jujur biaꞌkaꞌ.
Bɨɨx dhiꞌñi na jɨꞌk jix buam jir jum duuꞌnkam, ja jujur am dɨr jum gɨgɨꞌlhiꞌñ gu jaꞌtkam. Dhiꞌ ji na baꞌ puiꞌm kaiꞌch nax xidhuu, na guꞌ giilhim jir uaꞌtulhdharaꞌ.
Maaꞌn gu ubii na cham jir Israel kam na umuaꞌñdhaꞌ gu Jesuus na duaꞌñdhaꞌ gu maraaꞌn

Miꞌ dhɨr baꞌ ma jii gu Jesuus mummu maaꞌn kap, miaꞌn pɨx iam na paiꞌ gɇꞌr kiicham Tiiro tɨ tɨɨgim. Baꞌ miꞌ nat paiꞌ ai, tɨi cham paiꞌ jimmɨdaꞌ na tɨi cham aagɨt na jaroiꞌx mat kaꞌ na pa jaꞌk jax chuiꞌkaꞌ. Guꞌ ji nat guꞌ cham puiꞌ ji chu buus, moo janoꞌ puiꞌ ba tɨm tɨi.
Miꞌ ba jimchuꞌ maaꞌn gu ubii nat jax puiꞌ tɨ kai, na sap cham kɨɨꞌ tu iiꞌmdaꞌ kaꞌ maaꞌn gu maraaꞌn, ampɨx puiꞌx ñaanbiꞌ kaꞌ, baꞌ miꞌ oꞌlhiaꞌn kɨꞌn ji kɨkbu bɨɨpɨꞌ dɨr gu Jesuus.

Guiꞌ gu ubii cham tuꞌr Israel kam kaꞌ, pur miꞌ kam kaꞌ Peniisia, na Siiria bhaan bipioꞌ guiꞌ gu dɨbɨɨr. Baꞌ soiꞌ xi chɨtda, jup tɨtda na sap iam maiꞌ jootsaꞌ gu cham kɨɨꞌ iiꞌmdaꞌ bhaiꞌ dhɨr bhaan gu tɨɨyax.

Guꞌ ji na guꞌp tɨtda gu Jesuus: ―Ea nañ bɨɨpɨꞌ ka xi ja palhbuidhaꞌ gu Israel kam jaꞌtkam nañ baꞌ aap jup bam palhbuidhaꞌ. Na guꞌ noꞌ ñich aap bɨɨpɨꞌm palhbui, jaꞌp ji buusniaꞌ na jax gu aꞌaalh noꞌm ka tu kuaꞌ gu tuꞌ koiꞌ noꞌ ñich miꞌ dhɨr ja boppoidhak mu xi ja maa gu goꞌngox.

Baꞌp kaiꞌch gu ubii: ―Dho guꞌ puiꞌ dat do jia tɨi, guꞌ ji nañ guꞌ aañ soiꞌñ ɨlhiiꞌñ. ¿Cham aa guꞌ cham jax jup bua noꞌp moo xich joiꞌmdai jich palhbuidhaꞌ gɨt? Na guꞌ jaꞌp ji buusniaꞌ na jax noꞌm tɨ tɨɨtɨb gu goꞌngox gu biimuñgaꞌn na iigɨsdaꞌ paiꞌ nam tu kuaꞌdaꞌ gu aꞌaalh.
Baꞌp tɨtda gu Jesuus: ―Jaꞌpji moo sɨlhkam jia nap soiꞌm ɨlhiiꞌñ jiñ jaduuñ. Ba buus ji matgam gu cham kɨɨꞌ iiꞌmdaꞌ bhaiꞌ dhɨr bhaan gum maraax. Chaꞌp jax kam aaꞌndaꞌ, ba jimiaꞌ ap.
Baꞌ ba jii ɨp gu ubii. Nat paiꞌ dhuuk mu ai kiaꞌmiꞌñ, jix kɨɨꞌ mi jaꞌp boꞌm bakxidhat gu tɨɨyax, pu ba buus gu cham kɨɨꞌ iiꞌmdaꞌ bhaiꞌ dhɨr bhaan na kɨꞌn kax ñaanbiꞌ kat.
Gu Jesuus na ba duaꞌñdhaꞌ maaꞌn guiꞌ na cham tɇ kɇɇkɇꞌ gio na cham tu ñiokdaꞌ

Baꞌ miꞌ na paiꞌ daakat gu Jesuus miaꞌn gɇꞌ kiicham Tiiro tɨ tɨɨgim, miꞌ dhɨr giop ma jii, moo bhaiꞌ buus na paiꞌ Sidoon tɨ tɨɨꞌ, na puiꞌp jir gɇꞌ kiicham. Bhaiꞌ dhɨr jaꞌp gakoolh bhɨɨk mummu ba buus na paiꞌ Dekaapolis bhaan bipioꞌ gu dɨbɨɨr. Mu ji ai miaꞌn na paiꞌ gɇꞌ suuꞌnkaꞌ gu suudaiꞌ, na Galilea bhaan ba bipioꞌ.
Baꞌ miꞌ ba baiꞌñchuꞌ am gu jaꞌtkam maaꞌn gux koꞌkkam na cham tɇ kɇɇkɇꞌ gio na cham tu ñiokdaꞌ, baꞌ soiꞌ tɨtda am na sap palhɨɨp bhaiꞌ xi dhagiaꞌ na baꞌ dodhiaꞌ.
Baꞌ gu Jesuus jaꞌp jaꞌk xi baidhak dɨɨlhkob palhɨɨp bhɨjɨ xi kɨɨꞌmpi naankaran, gio baꞌ nat xi xixbuidhak gu nobiiꞌñ palhɨɨp bhaiꞌ xi dhaa nɨɨnɨran.
Gio baꞌ nat jax jix dhaam jaꞌk xi chɨ tɨɨgɨk iiꞌmdagaꞌn xi buak jup kaiꞌch: ―¡Epaata! ―na jaꞌp kaiꞌñkam jup jum kaiꞌch: ¡Xim kukpioꞌk!
Baꞌ joidham bhaiꞌ jim kukpioꞌ gu naankaꞌn guiꞌ na cham tɇ kɇɇkat, gio gu nɨɨnɨꞌn pu dua ɨp, jix bhaiꞌ ba tu aꞌga.
Baꞌp ja tɨtda gu Jesuus guiꞌ nam miꞌp tuꞌiiꞌ nam sap cham jaroiꞌ aagiꞌñdhaꞌ nat jax dhuuk duaꞌñ, guꞌ ji nam guꞌ guiꞌ moo janoꞌ naiꞌ pɨx jaꞌx puiꞌ tu ja aꞌgiꞌñ, sia kut tɨi xi ja sooꞌmcholhdhak.

Baꞌ gu jaꞌtkam guiꞌ nam puiꞌ tu ja aꞌgiꞌñdhaꞌ miꞌ puiꞌ pup tuiꞌkaꞌ am, jaꞌxpɨx dai nam jup kaiꞌchdhaꞌ: ―¡Joidham dho bak jia! Jaiñ na guꞌ puiꞌ ja duduaꞌñdhim guiꞌ nam cham tɇ kɇɇ gio guiꞌ nam cham tu ñiok.
